⚠ .env 已经推送到远端
应立即把其中的密钥视为已经泄露
1
立即到服务平台轮换或吊销该密钥，并创建新的密钥
2
先备份，并按托管平台与团队流程评估是否清理历史。共享仓库需要协调协作者、分支和开放中的 PR；个人不要直接改写历史
BFG 或 git filter-repo 只是可选工具，改写后通常还涉及受控强推；Fork、缓存或旧克隆也可能保留对象。验收时先确认旧密钥已经失效

⚠ .env was pushed to the remote repository
Treat the key as compromised immediately
1
Use the service provider to rotate or revoke the key, then create a replacement
2
Coordinate any history cleanup with the team and hosting provider. Rewriting shared history affects collaborators, branches, and open pull requests.
BFG and git filter-repo can help remove a secret from Git history, but forks, caches, and old clones may keep copies. Verify first that the exposed key no longer works.

use.t: 在项目开始时就建立 .gitignore，并用状态列表检查结果
排除 node_modules 等能根据项目配置重新生成的内容
排除真实密钥文件，并提交不含真值的示例配置
参考官方或社区模板后，再按当前项目调整规则

dont.t: 把依赖目录提交到仓库，增加体积并制造无关差异
把 .gitignore 当成加密工具；它只是告诉 Git 不要记录
文件已经被跟踪后才补规则；还要另外停止跟踪
密钥已经泄露却只删除文件，没有立即更换密钥

lessonPractice.title: 真实 `.env` 已经提交并推到远端，现在才把它写进 `.gitignore`。还需要做什么？

options.label: 停止跟踪文件、保留无密钥示例，并立即轮换已经泄露的凭证
options.feedback: 忽略规则只影响未跟踪内容，历史中的密钥已经暴露，必须作废和更换。

options.label: 只提交 `.gitignore`，旧文件和旧密钥会自动从历史消失
options.feedback: 已跟踪文件不会因新规则消失，历史提交中的内容也仍然存在。

options.label: 保留原密钥继续使用，因为 `.gitignore` 已经把它加密隐藏
options.feedback: Gitignore 只是匹配排除规则，不会加密已经提交或本地保存的内容。

en.title: A real .env was already committed and pushed before being added to .gitignore. What else must happen?

options.label: Stop tracking it, keep a secret-free example, and immediately rotate exposed credentials
options.feedback: Ignore rules affect untracked content only, and credentials exposed in history must be revoked and replaced.

options.label: Commit only .gitignore and assume the old file and secret disappear from history
options.feedback: Tracked files do not vanish from a new rule, and prior commit content remains.

options.label: Keep using the old secret because .gitignore has now encrypted and hidden it
options.feedback: Gitignore is a matching rule, not encryption for committed or local content.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查 `.env` 是否已被 Git 跟踪；若已提交，先停止跟踪并加入 `.gitignore`，提交不含真值的 `.env.example`。列出所有暴露凭证并立即轮换，不要把忽略规则当成历史清除或加密。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Check whether .env is tracked; if committed, stop tracking it, add it to .gitignore, and keep a value-free .env.example. List and rotate every exposed credential, and never treat ignore rules as history removal or encryption.

entry.demoDetail:
index.html 会记录style.css 会记录.env 不记录
×.gitignore把本地密钥挡在版本历史外
.gitignore 中写入 .env

.gitignore 告诉 Git 哪些“还没被记录过的新文件”不要加入版本历史。它不能清除已经提交的密钥；密钥一旦泄露，要立即更换。

en.demoDetail:
index.html Trackedstyle.css Tracked.env Ignored
×.gitignoreKeep local secrets out of version control
Add .env to .gitignore

A .gitignore file tells Git which untracked files and folders it should ignore. It does not remove a file that has already been committed. If a secret was exposed, rotate or revoke it immediately.

use.t: Keep local environment files out of commits

dont.t: Assume it removes a file already committed
Ignore source files just to hide an accidental change
Commit a secret first and add it to .gitignore later
Use broad patterns without checking what else they match
